### You Can’t Have Beauty Without Ashes
Author: Kim Potter
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/women/you-can-t-have-beauty-without-ashes.html
Passage: Isaiah 61:3
Points:
- Believers desire the promise of beauty, but beauty cannot arrive without going through ashes first.
- Ashes require fire, reflecting God's refining work that purifies believers of sin and compromise.
- God's fire does not destroy like an incinerator; it refines like silver to remove impurities.
- Surrendering fully to the refining fire removes hindrances so God can display His glory.
